reviews.text:
Dear Candice, 

Thank you for your kind rating. 

Elizavet Team

My experience at Elizavet has been exceptional. During a difficult time with my 5 month old kitten, the whole team showed incredible kindness and support. They offered the most affordable quote I received, even compared to charity vets, and the option to spread payments monthly.
Even the smaller details such as after care, pain relief and post op appointments.
A special thank you to Dr Dario and Ana for their genuine care and reassurance. I’m incredibly grateful for everything they’ve done for my baby.

Dear Malcoln, 

Thank you for your kind rating. 

Best regards,
Elizavet Clinic

Staff were over and beyond helpful , genuinely caring

Parking is difficult and the wardens are based in an unmarked building opposite

Excellent service. I took my cat for a heart scan. The stuff was very welcoming, polite, helpful and answered all my questions to make me feel clear and at ease! The best thing, that in my experience a lot of pet clinics lack is that they actually took a minute and told me what is happening and how before and after!!! If my home was closer I would want this to be my permanent clinic!
Very nice and qualified people
My dog had knee surgery a week ago, all went well. Doctor's nurses and staff are all very nice and really care for your pets.

My cat was referred from Snoots for an ultrasound for a tumour. Nichole took the time to review the results of the scan, give next steps, and answer questions, both over the phone when the test was done, and in person when I collected my cat. As a Snoots member, the cost of the appointment was covered and everything was super easy.

Honestly the best veterinary practice I’ve had. And I’ve been to SO many over the years. Everyone is so kind, helpful, empathetic and my dog’s surgeon Dario is amazing. Thankyou all for everything you’ve done so far for Mousey 🫶🏻 …
They were so friendly and kind for my cat, and explained all the steps for our treatment.

Our 1-year-old corgi (Bagel) was referred to Elizavet by our primary vet Snoots for a recurring fever. When his condition deteriorated Elizavet was always able to hospitalise him same day for treatment and monitoring. We were in and out of the clinic for 2 - 3 weeks for tests and consultations including ultrasound, CT scan and spinal tap. I believe Bagel received the best care by the team at Elizavet led by Dr Arietta and Dr Dario. We received regular communications throughout. Their service is personal and empathetic. For a vet clinic/surgery, they have expertise in different fields and facilities for advanced procedures. Our dog felt very comfortable there. Apart from one time where we had to wait for almost an hour for discharge, for the rest of our visits we were quickly attended to but the consultations were never rushed. I would recommend Elizavet to any pet owner.

Our cockapoo was diagnosed with elbow dysplasia and osteoarthritis in May. We were advised to seek physio and hydrotherapy for her and the thought was quite daunting. It was such a relief to discover that Elizavet which is local to us, offers both. I can’t recommend their physio Izzy more highly. She is absolutely lovely, very kind and knowledgeable and has worked wonders with our cockapoo.

We cannot thank Dario and the team at Elizavet enough for the incredible care they gave our little Frances. She needed emergency surgery and from the moment we arrived, we felt she was in the very best hands. Dario was brilliant – incredibly thorough, kind and reassuring throughout – and the whole team took such wonderful care of her. We are so grateful to them for getting Frances well again. THANK YOU ❤️

A huge thank you to everyone at Elizavet for taking such amazing care of our cat, Ozzie, during his neutering procedure. From the moment we arrived, the whole team made us feel reassured and looked after.

Ozzie recovered so well after his surgery, and we’re incredibly grateful for the excellent care and advice we received throughout.

Thank you for doing such a fantastic job and for treating Ozzie with so much love and compassion!

I feel so lucky to have found Elizavet! When I say I trust them completely, I don’t just mean that I trust their medical judgement and expertise. I trust them because I know my dogs will be treated with kindness, patience and genuine affection when they are there and for me that matters just as much.

There is something very different about the atmosphere here. Elizavet feels warm, welcoming and personal in a way that veterinary practices so often don’t. It feels like everyone genuinely cares, not just about the animals they’re treating, but about the people attached to them too. Anna on reception deserves a special mention because she was the very first person I met when I came here, and I remember immediately thinking that I felt welcome. She makes such a difference to the whole practice. She is kind, helpful, reassuring and somehow always seems to make everything easier. When you’re worried about your dog, having someone like that as the first person you see or speak to means more than people probably realise.

The veterinary expertise is also exceptional. I originally came here for a second opinion after another local vet had told me that my dog was absolutely fine and wasn’t in pain. I brought along the X-rays that had already been taken and was given a second-opinion consultation completely free of charge. They immediately recognised that the X-rays themselves were extremely poor quality, yet were still able to identify what was wrong with him and explain it to me clearly for the best part of an hour. He went on to have surgery with them, and the difference it has made to his quality of life has been enormous. Knowing that I was right to keep pushing for him, and finally finding people who actually listened and could see what was wrong, meant so much to me.

One of the things I value most is that they are both a GP practice and a referral practice. Having that breadth of knowledge and expertise all under one roof, without having to travel miles across London every time something more complicated comes up, is something I don’t take for granted at all.

Their in house physiotherapy and hydrotherapy service has been another huge part of why I love this practice. I’ve used a lot of physios and hydros over the years, but I’ve never experienced anything as thorough or purposeful as the care here. Every session feels considered and Issy takes notes each time, tracks progress and sets homework. There is always a clear plan for what we are working towards, you never feel like you are simply turning up for another session and you feel like you are actively helping your dog improve. The physio can speak directly with your dog’s surgeon/vet, and they can even pop into a session to watch how your dog is moving and see their progress for themselves. It sounds like such a small thing, but the direct communication between the physio and vet not only saves time, but reduces the chance of things being misunderstood or important details being lost in translation.

When you love your dogs as much as I do, finding people you trust with them is a very big deal. After years of trying different vets and travelling all over London looking for the right people, I finally feel like I’ve found the place I was looking for. I’m genuinely so grateful to have them nearby and to know that, when one of my dogs needs help, they are in the hands of people I trust entirely. My only complaint is that they aren’t fully 24 hours yet, because at this point I really don’t want my dogs going anywhere else.

I can’t recommend ElizaVet highly enough. I’ve used a lot of different veterinary practices across London over the years, and genuinely, nothing compares to the level of care we’ve experienced here.

We’ve only been with ElizaVet since the end of April, but in that relatively short time they’ve made such a lasting impression. I have a rescue dog who can be quite anxious about being handled, and the team have been incredibly patient, gentle and understanding with him. He’s  comfortable with the team now, which is a real testament to the way they approach animals and the trust they take the time to build.

We’ve had to visit quite a few times with various issues, and every time I’ve been struck by how attentive and proactive they are. They’re incredibly thorough, but also very calm and reassuring, and there’s a genuine sense that they want to get to the bottom of what’s going on rather than simply treating the immediate problem and sending you on your way. Consultations never feel rushed, and they actually listen to your concerns. The level of ongoing care and follow up has also been fantastic, you really feel that they care about your animals beyond the appointment itself.

The atmosphere at ElizaVet is something else I love. It doesn’t feel like a typical vet practice at all. It’s warm, welcoming and genuinely friendly, and there’s such a calm feeling when you walk through the door. It feels much more like a big family than a veterinary team, and that makes such a difference.

I also have to give a special mention to Anna on reception. She is an absolute gem and such a wonderful part of the practice. She goes above and beyond to make people feel welcome and looked after, and she brings such warmth and kindness to every interaction. She’s genuinely lovely, an asset to the practice.

Ultimately, what makes ElizaVet stand out is the combination of expertise, compassion and the breadth of care they’re able to provide. They have an incredibly knowledgeable team, not to mention the fantastic physiotherapist, Izzy who works alongside your vet in supporting your pets. You feel like your pets are in capable hands from the moment you walk in, while still receiving that very personal, thoughtful level of care.

We feel incredibly lucky to have found ElizaVet, and I wouldn’t hesitate in recommending them!

I honestly can’t recommend Dario and the team at Eliza Vets enough. Roxy came under Dario’s care following a road traffic accident where she sustained pelvic fractures and was unable to walk. It was an incredibly frightening time, but from the very beginning Dario and the team was so thorough, reassuring and genuinely caring.

Rather than rushing into unnecessary surgery, they carefully assessed Roxy and put together a conservative treatment and rehabilitation plan for her, with strict rest followed by gradual rehabilitation and physiotherapy. They have continued to monitor her recovery and has always taken the time to explain everything to me properly, answer my endless questions and make sure I understand exactly what I should be doing with her at home. I’ve never felt rushed or like any concern was too small.

A huge thank you also has to go to Izzy for Roxy’s physiotherapy. She has been absolutely amazing with her. Roxy is a tiny, nervous dog and Izzy has been incredibly patient and gentle, while giving me really clear exercises and advice to continue her rehabilitation at home. Seeing the improvements as the weeks have gone on has been incredible.

I’d also like to add how helpful and supportive all the the reception staff have been. Ana is the only receptionist whose name I know, but every single person I’ve spoken to has been kind and helpful. Whether it’s been arranging appointments, answering questions or helping when I’ve been worried about Roxy, everyone has always made me feel welcome and looked after.

Dario and Izzy and the team have supported us through every stage of what has been a long and stressful recovery, and they have made whole experience so much easier. I genuinely cannot thank them enough and would recommend them for anyone ❤️🐾
Thank you so much for your 5 star rating 🐾😊 …

Saved our sweet dog Cody after Veteris discharged him while he still had stomach ulcers and was losing a lot of blood in his stool. Forever grateful for Elizavet, especially Nicole, Christina and of course Dario.

We've been bringing our cat, David, to Elizavet since he was just a tiny kitten, and we honestly couldn't be happier with the care he's received.
The whole team has always been incredibly kind, professional, and genuinely caring. Every visit, they've taken the time to explain everything clearly, answer all of our questions, and make sure David is as comfortable as possible. You can tell that everyone here truly loves animals and treats them as if they were their own.
It's such a relief knowing that David is in safe hands whenever we need to visit. The level of compassion, attention to detail, and professionalism has been consistently outstanding from day one.
Thank you to everyone at Elizavet for looking after David so well. We wouldn't hesitate to recommend your clinic to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care.
